officialProductPage.evidence: Nordica's 26/27 product page confirms sizes 155/161/167/173/179 cm; radius 16.5/17/17.5/18/18.5 m; 102 mm waist; 155 cm sidecut 128-102-118 mm; 179 cm sidecut 133-102-123 mm; pair weight 4320 g at 179 cm; TSM Pulse Core; Performance Wood + Terrain Specific Metal + Sidewall + Pulse Core; All Mountain rocker; True Tip; factory base/side angles 0.9/87.5 degrees.
